blocks.zh: Section 1: Deterministic Test Methods | 確定性試驗方法
blocks.en: Section 1: Deterministic Test Methods

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 Deterministic Test Methods（確定性試驗方法）的核心原理：基於物理化學原理，給出客觀定量數據
blocks.en: Master the core principle of deterministic test methods: they are based on physical and chemical principles and give objective, quantitative data

blocks.zh: 理解 Vacuum/Pressure Decay（真空/壓力衰減）、High Voltage Leak Detection（高壓電洩漏檢測，HVLD）、Headspace Analysis（頭部空間分析）等主要方法的工作原理
blocks.en: Understand how the main methods work, including vacuum/pressure decay, High Voltage Leak Detection (HVLD) and headspace analysis

blocks.zh: 了解 Mass Extraction（質量萃取）和 Tracer Gas Methods（示蹤氣體法，包含氦質譜）的技術特點與應用場景
blocks.en: Understand the technical characteristics and applications of mass extraction and tracer gas methods (including helium mass spectrometry)

blocks.zh: 能夠依據包裝類型、產品特性及測試目的選擇合適的確定性方法
blocks.en: Be able to select a suitable deterministic method based on package type, product characteristics and test purpose

blocks.zh: 理解確定性方法在方法驗證、量化能力和 FDA 監管期望方面的優勢
blocks.en: Understand the advantages of deterministic methods in method validation, quantitative capability and FDA regulatory expectations

blocks.zh: Overview: Deterministic Test Methods Framework | 確定性方法框架概述
blocks.en: Overview: Deterministic Test Methods Framework

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 確定性 vs. 概率性方法的本質差別：
blocks.en: The essential difference between deterministic and probabilistic methods:

blocks.zh: 確定性（Deterministic）方法：每次測試的結果都依循可預測的物理規律。例如，你施加一個真空，觀察壓力回升速度——如果有洩漏，壓力就會回升，這是必然的物理現象。儀器給出的是一個壓力讀數（定量數值）。
blocks.en: Deterministic methods: the result of every test follows predictable physical laws. For example, you apply a vacuum and watch how fast the pressure rises. If there is a leak, the pressure will rise; this is a physical certainty. The instrument gives a pressure reading (a quantitative value).

blocks.zh: 概率性（Probabilistic）方法：結果依賴一系列隨機事件。例如染料浸入試驗，染料是否進入取決於染料濃度、浸泡時間、毛細管效應、操作者判斷等多種隨機因素。最終的「通過/不通過」帶有主觀性。
blocks.en: Probabilistic methods: the result depends on a series of random events. In a dye ingress test, for example, whether dye enters depends on dye concentration, immersion time, capillary effects, operator judgment and other random factors. The final "pass/fail" is subjective.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — FDA 的立場
blocks.en: Key Notes: the FDA's position

blocks.zh: FDA 在 2023 年更新的容器密封完整性指引中，明確傾向確定性方法。監管機構的邏輯很清楚：確定性方法給出可量化數據（如 1.2×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s），可以直接與已建立的 MALL 比較，而概率性方法的「沒有染料進入」只是一個主觀觀察。
blocks.en: In its guidance on container closure integrity updated in 2023, the FDA clearly favors deterministic methods. The regulator's logic is straightforward: a deterministic method gives quantifiable data (for example, 1.2×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s) that can be compared directly with an established MALL, whereas "no dye ingress" from a probabilistic method is only a subjective observation.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的實務影響：如果你的產品仍在用染料浸入法作為主要 CCI 測試，應該認真考慮遷移到確定性方法，並準備好遷移驗證（method transfer/bridging study）的計畫。
blocks.en: Practical impact for a CDMO: if your product still uses dye ingress as its primary CCI test, you should seriously consider moving to a deterministic method and prepare a method transfer/bridging study plan.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 確定性方法就像用數位血壓計量血壓——每次都給出一個精確數字（120/80 mmHg），可以與正常值直接比較。概率性方法像中醫把脈——有經驗的醫師可以判斷，但結果因人而異、難以量化。現代監管要求的是「數位血壓計」式的客觀數據。
blocks.en: A deterministic method is like measuring blood pressure with a digital monitor: every time it gives a precise number (120/80 mmHg) that can be compared directly with the normal range. A probabilistic method is like traditional Chinese pulse diagnosis: an experienced practitioner can make a judgment, but the result varies from person to person and is hard to quantify. Modern regulators want objective data of the "digital blood pressure monitor" type.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼確定性方法的測試結果更容易在不同實驗室間比較（inter-laboratory reproducibility）？
blocks.en: Why are the results of deterministic methods easier to compare between laboratories (inter-laboratory reproducibility)?

blocks.zh: 一個方法給出的是「沒有氣泡」（氣泡法），這是確定性還是概率性？為什麼？
blocks.en: A method gives the result "no bubbles" (bubble test). Is this deterministic or probabilistic? Why?

blocks.zh: 1.1 Vacuum Decay / Pressure Decay Methods | 真空衰減法 / 壓力衰減法
blocks.en: 1.1 Vacuum Decay / Pressure Decay Methods

blocks.zh: Vacuum Decay (真空衰減法): In vacuum decay testing, the test package is placed in a sealed test chamber, and a vacuum is drawn. If the package has a leak, gas from inside the package will escape into the test chamber, causing the chamber vacuum (absolute pressure) to rise. The rate of pressure increase is measured and correlated to the leakage rate. Vacuum decay instruments can detect leaks in vials, bottles, blister packs, flexible pouches, and other package types.
blocks.en: Vacuum Decay: In vacuum decay testing, the test package is placed in a sealed test chamber, and a vacuum is drawn. If the package has a leak, gas from inside the package will escape into the test chamber, causing the chamber vacuum (absolute pressure) to rise. The rate of pressure increase is measured and correlated to the leakage rate. Vacuum decay instruments can detect leaks in vials, bottles, blister packs, flexible pouches, and other package types.

blocks.zh: Pressure Decay (壓力衰減法): In pressure decay testing, the test package headspace (or the test chamber) is pressurized, and the rate of pressure decrease is monitored. A leak will cause the pressure to decay more rapidly. This method is applicable to packages where internal pressurization is feasible.
blocks.en: Pressure Decay: In pressure decay testing, the test package headspace (or the test chamber) is pressurized, and the rate of pressure decrease is monitored. A leak will cause the pressure to decay more rapidly. This method is applicable to packages where internal pressurization is feasible.

blocks.zh: 真空衰減法的工作原理：
blocks.en: How vacuum decay works:

blocks.zh: 想像把西林瓶放入一個密封箱，然後抽真空。如果瓶子密封完好，裡面的氣體跑不出來，箱子的真空保持穩定。如果瓶子有洩漏，裡面的氣體會慢慢漏進箱子，導致真空度下降（絕對壓力上升）——儀器偵測到這個壓力變化，就判定洩漏。
blocks.en: Imagine putting a vial into a sealed chamber and drawing a vacuum. If the vial is well sealed, the gas inside cannot escape and the chamber vacuum stays stable. If the vial leaks, the gas inside slowly leaks into the chamber and the vacuum level falls (absolute pressure rises). The instrument detects this pressure change and declares a leak.

blocks.zh: 靈敏度範圍：不同儀器設計的靈敏度差異很大。高端設備可達 10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s 量級，可以偵測比 MALL 更小的洩漏。
blocks.en: Sensitivity range: Sensitivity varies widely between instrument designs. High-end equipment can reach the 10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s level, which can detect leaks smaller than the MALL.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation

blocks.zh:
真空衰減法的基本原理：

測試步驟：
1. 將包裝放入密封測試室
2. 抽真空至目標壓力（如 1–10 mbar 絕對壓力）
3. 隔離測試室，監測壓力變化 ΔP/Δt

洩漏速率估算：
Q (mbar·L/s) ≈ ΔP(mbar) × V_chamber(L) / Δt(s)

校準要求：
- 使用已知孔徑的正對照（positive control）
- 建立壓力變化率與洩漏速率的相關曲線
- 系統適用性驗證（system suitability）在每次測試前確認

靈敏度範圍（典型值）：
- 高端儀器：~10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s
- 常規設備：~10⁻³ to 10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s
blocks.en:
Basic principle of vacuum decay:

Test steps:
1. Place the package in the sealed test chamber
2. Draw a vacuum to the target pressure (e.g., 1–10 mbar absolute pressure)
3. Isolate the test chamber and monitor the pressure change ΔP/Δt

Leak rate estimate:
Q (mbar·L/s) ≈ ΔP(mbar) × V_chamber(L) / Δt(s)

Calibration requirements:
- Use a positive control with a known orifice size
- Establish a correlation curve between rate of pressure change and leak rate
- Confirm system suitability before each test

Sensitivity range (typical values):
- High-end instruments: ~10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s
- Conventional equipment: ~10⁻³ to 10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 彈性包裝的挑戰：真空衰減法對剛性容器（vials, cartridges）效果最好。對於軟袋（flexible bags）、泡罩包裝（blister packs）等有彈性的包裝，真空施加時包裝本身會變形，導致壓力讀數受到干擾（包裝收縮產生假陽性）。這種情況需要特殊的夾具設計或選用其他方法。
blocks.en: The challenge of flexible packaging: Vacuum decay works best on rigid containers (vials, cartridges). For flexible bags, blister packs and other flexible packages, the package itself deforms when vacuum is applied, which interferes with the pressure reading (package contraction causes false positives). Such cases need a special fixture design or a different method.

blocks.zh: 生產線整合：真空衰減法可整合到自動化充填封蓋生產線，實現 100% 線上檢測，是凍乾西林瓶和注射劑生產中最常見的 CCI 測試方式之一。
blocks.en: Production line integration: Vacuum decay can be integrated into automated filling and closing lines to achieve 100% inline testing. It is one of the most common CCI test methods for lyophilized vials and injectable production.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的生產驗證中，真空衰減法常用作西林瓶批放行的 CCI 測試。驗證計畫應包括：①靈敏度評估（最小可檢測洩漏）；②特異性（是否有假陽性，例如殘留水分影響）；③樣品代表性（不同充填量、不同橡膠塞批次）；④ 100% 線上檢測的系統適用性規程。
blocks.en: In CDMO production validation, vacuum decay is often used as the CCI test for vial batch release. The validation plan should include: (1) sensitivity assessment (minimum detectable leak); (2) specificity (whether false positives occur, for example from residual moisture); (3) sample representativeness (different fill volumes, different stopper lots); and (4) a system suitability procedure for 100% inline testing.

blocks.zh: 為什麼充填了大量液體（如 50 mL）的西林瓶，比充填 2 mL 的西林瓶更難用真空衰減法檢測？提示：考慮頭部空間體積的影響。
blocks.en: Why is a vial filled with a large volume of liquid (e.g., 50 mL) harder to test by vacuum decay than one filled with 2 mL? Hint: consider the effect of headspace volume.

blocks.zh: 如果你的凍乾品在充氮條件下密封，真空衰減法是否仍然適用？為什麼需要特別評估？
blocks.en: If your lyophilized product is sealed under a nitrogen atmosphere, is vacuum decay still applicable? Why does it need special evaluation?

blocks.zh: 1.2 High Voltage Leak Detection (HVLD) | 高壓電洩漏檢測法
blocks.en: 1.2 High Voltage Leak Detection (HVLD)

blocks.zh: High Voltage Leak Detection (HVLD, 高壓電洩漏檢測) is a deterministic, nondestructive integrity testing method based on electrochemical principles. HVLD is referenced in USP 〈1207.2〉 as one of the key physicochemical integrity test technologies.
blocks.en: High Voltage Leak Detection (HVLD) is a deterministic, nondestructive integrity testing method based on electrochemical principles. HVLD is referenced in USP <1207.2> as one of the key physicochemical integrity test technologies.

blocks.zh: HVLD 的工作原理：把一個充滿導電液體的玻璃瓶想像成電池中的電解質。當你在瓶子外壁施加高電壓時，如果瓶壁完好，電流無法穿透。一旦有針孔缺陷，導電液體透過缺陷形成電流通路，電阻驟降、電流飆升——儀器偵測到這個電信號異常就判定洩漏。
blocks.en: How HVLD works: Think of a glass vial filled with conductive liquid as the electrolyte in a battery. When a high voltage is applied to the outer wall of the vial, current cannot pass through if the wall is intact. If there is a pinhole defect, the conductive liquid forms a current path through the defect, resistance drops sharply and current spikes. The instrument detects this electrical signal anomaly and declares a leak.

blocks.zh: 關鍵限制條件：產品必須具有電導性（ionic conductivity，離子導電性）。這是 HVLD 最重要的適用前提——凍乾粉、油性製劑、非水溶液通常不適用。
blocks.en: Key limitation: The product must be electrically conductive (ionic conductivity). This is the most important prerequisite for HVLD; lyophilized powders, oil-based formulations and non-aqueous solutions are generally not suitable.

blocks.zh: HVLD 就像在泳池水面施加電壓——如果水裡沒有任何連通外界的破口，電流被絕緣材料（玻璃壁）阻斷。一旦玻璃壁有針孔，導電的水與外部形成迴路，就像保險絲短路一樣立即被偵測。這也說明為什麼純水（去離子水）或油性製劑難以用 HVLD 測試——沒有足夠的離子導電性，即使有破口也不會形成有效的電流迴路。
blocks.en: HVLD is like applying a voltage across the surface of a swimming pool. If there is no break connecting the water to the outside, the current is blocked by the insulating material (the glass wall). Once the glass wall has a pinhole, the conductive water forms a circuit with the outside, and, like a blown fuse, it is detected immediately. This also explains why pure (deionized) water or oil-based formulations are difficult to test by HVLD: without sufficient ionic conductivity, even a breach will not form an effective current circuit.

blocks.zh: HVLD 的獨特優勢：HVLD 是少數能直接偵測容器壁針孔（而非只偵測密封區域）的方法。玻璃瓶在製造過程中可能存在極細微的氣泡或薄弱點，這類缺陷在真空衰減法中可能因洩漏量極小而漏網，但 HVLD 對幾微米的針孔仍有靈敏度。
blocks.en: The unique advantage of HVLD: HVLD is one of the few methods that can directly detect pinholes in the container wall (rather than only the sealing area). Glass vials may contain extremely fine bubbles or weak points from the manufacturing process. Such defects may escape vacuum decay because the leakage is so small, but HVLD remains sensitive to pinholes of a few micrometers.

blocks.zh: 電壓選擇：電壓需要根據容器壁厚度和材質優化。過低的電壓會降低靈敏度，過高的電壓可能損傷容器或影響產品（需要驗證電壓對產品無影響）。
blocks.en: Voltage selection: The voltage must be optimized for the container wall thickness and material. Too low a voltage reduces sensitivity; too high a voltage may damage the container or affect the product (it must be verified that the voltage has no effect on the product).

blocks.zh: 你的工廠同時生產含緩衝鹽的注射液（離子強度高）和含 5% 葡萄糖溶液（離子強度低）。哪一個更適合用 HVLD？需要做什麼評估？
blocks.en: Your plant produces both an injection containing buffer salts (high ionic strength) and a 5% dextrose solution (low ionic strength). Which is more suitable for HVLD? What evaluation is needed?

blocks.zh: 凍乾產品在乾粉狀態下（尚未復溶）是否能用 HVLD 測試？如果不能，有什麼替代方法？
blocks.en: Can a lyophilized product in its dry powder state (before reconstitution) be tested by HVLD? If not, what alternative methods are there?

blocks.zh: 1.3 Headspace Analysis | 頭部空間分析法
blocks.en: 1.3 Headspace Analysis

blocks.zh: Headspace Analysis (頭部空間分析) is a deterministic leak test method that monitors the composition or pressure of gas in the headspace of a container as an indicator of package integrity. It is particularly valuable for packages where headspace gas content is a critical quality attribute, and is referenced in USP 〈1207.2〉.
blocks.en: Headspace Analysis is a deterministic leak test method that monitors the composition or pressure of gas in the headspace of a container as an indicator of package integrity. It is particularly valuable for packages where headspace gas content is a critical quality attribute, and is referenced in USP <1207.2>.

blocks.zh: Headspace Gas Analysis (Laser-Based / Near-Infrared Spectroscopy): Uses tunable diode laser absorption spectroscopy (TDLAS, 可調二極體雷射吸收光譜) or near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy to measure the concentration of specific gases (e.g., O₂, CO₂, H₂O vapor) in the headspace of a sealed container without opening it. A leak will manifest as a change in headspace gas composition over time (e.g., rising O₂ in a nitrogen-purged vial).
blocks.en: Headspace Gas Analysis (Laser-Based / Near-Infrared Spectroscopy): Uses tunable diode laser absorption spectroscopy (TDLAS) or near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy to measure the concentration of specific gases (e.g., O₂, CO₂, H₂O vapor) in the headspace of a sealed container without opening it. A leak will manifest as a change in headspace gas composition over time (e.g., rising O₂ in a nitrogen-purged vial).

blocks.zh: 頭部空間分析的核心邏輯：這個方法的獨特之處在於它直接量測的是「產品品質」而不只是「包裝缺陷」。對於一個充氮保護的生物製劑，氧氣濃度上升不只代表有洩漏，更直接代表產品的氧化風險。這讓測試結果與臨床品質屬性（CQA）直接掛鉤。
blocks.en: The core logic of headspace analysis: What is unique about this method is that it directly measures "product quality" and not only "package defects". For a nitrogen-protected biologic, a rise in oxygen concentration indicates not only a leak but, more directly, an oxidation risk to the product. This ties the test result directly to the critical quality attributes (CQAs).

blocks.zh: TDLAS 技術：可調二極體雷射吸收光譜（TDLAS）利用特定氣體分子對特定波長雷射的吸收特性來定量。O₂ 在特定近紅外波長有強吸收峰。雷射穿透玻璃瓶後，根據吸收量計算出頭部空間氧氣濃度——全程非接觸，不需要刺破瓶塞。
blocks.en: TDLAS technology: Tunable diode laser absorption spectroscopy (TDLAS) quantifies specific gas molecules using their absorption of laser light at specific wavelengths. O₂ has a strong absorption peak at a particular near-infrared wavelength. After the laser passes through the glass vial, the headspace oxygen concentration is calculated from the amount absorbed. The whole process is non-contact and does not require piercing the stopper.

blocks.zh: TDLAS 就像隔著玻璃用紅外線溫度計量體溫——不需要接觸，雷射穿過玻璃直接量到目標物質的特性。相比之下，傳統的頭部空間氣體分析需要插針取樣，是破壞性的。TDLAS 讓你可以在整個穩定性研究期間對同一支西林瓶反覆測量，追蹤氧氣濃度的時間趨勢。
blocks.en: TDLAS is like taking a temperature through glass with an infrared thermometer: no contact is needed, and the laser passes through the glass to measure the property of the target substance directly. By contrast, traditional headspace gas analysis requires inserting a needle to sample, which is destructive. TDLAS lets you measure the same vial repeatedly throughout a stability study and track the oxygen concentration trend over time.

blocks.zh: 穩定性研究中的連續監測：頭部空間分析特別適合在穩定性研究中使用，因為它可以非破壞性地在同一批次上重複測量（0、3、6、12、24 個月）。如果 O₂ 濃度在某個時間點突然上升，可以及時發現「慢速洩漏（chronic leak）」——這種洩漏在生產時的 100% 檢測中可能因洩漏速率極慢而未被發現。
blocks.en: Continuous monitoring in stability studies: Headspace analysis is particularly suitable for stability studies because it can be measured repeatedly and nondestructively on the same batch (0, 3, 6, 12, 24 months). If the O₂ concentration suddenly rises at a certain time point, a "chronic leak" (slow leak) can be found in time. Such a leak may go unnoticed in 100% testing during production because the leak rate is extremely slow.

blocks.zh: 凍乾品的特殊應用：凍乾西林瓶通常在部分真空下密封（如 100 mbar 絕對壓力），定期進行頭部空間壓力監測是評估密封品質的標準做法。FDA 在檢查中常問及凍乾品的 CCI 策略，TDLAS 或壓力監測是監管認可的確定性方法。
blocks.en: Special application to lyophilized products: Lyophilized vials are usually sealed under partial vacuum (e.g., 100 mbar absolute pressure), and periodic headspace pressure monitoring is standard practice for evaluating seal quality. The FDA often asks about the CCI strategy for lyophilized products during inspections, and TDLAS or pressure monitoring are regulator-accepted deterministic methods.

blocks.zh: 一個單株抗體凍乾品，在 6 個月穩定性時程中 O₂ 從 0.5% 升至 2.5%。這是否一定代表有洩漏？還有哪些可能的原因需要排除？
blocks.en: For a lyophilized monoclonal antibody, O₂ rose from 0.5% to 2.5% over a 6-month stability time course. Does this necessarily indicate a leak? What other possible causes need to be ruled out?

blocks.zh: TDLAS 只能量測特定氣體（O₂、CO₂）。如果你的產品在氬氣（Ar）氛圍下密封，如何用頭部空間分析評估密封完整性？
blocks.en: TDLAS can only measure specific gases (O₂, CO₂). If your product is sealed under an argon (Ar) atmosphere, how would you evaluate seal integrity using headspace analysis?

blocks.zh: 1.4 Mass Extraction Method | 質量萃取法
blocks.en: 1.4 Mass Extraction Method

blocks.zh: The Mass Extraction method (質量萃取法) is a deterministic vacuum-based leak test technique referenced in USP 〈1207.2〉. It is related to vacuum decay but provides a more direct measurement of gas flow rather than inferring leakage from pressure change alone.
blocks.en: The Mass Extraction method is a deterministic vacuum-based leak test technique referenced in USP <1207.2>. It is related to vacuum decay but provides a more direct measurement of gas flow rather than inferring leakage from pressure change alone.

blocks.zh: 質量萃取 vs. 真空衰減：兩者都是「負壓驅動」的方法，差異在於量測的物理量：真空衰減量測的是壓力變化率（△P/△t）；質量萃取直接量測從包裝中萃出的氣體質量或體積。對於大體積頭部空間的包裝（如大輸液袋），微小洩漏引起的壓力變化可能很小（測量不精確），但氣體萃取量的直接計量則更可靠。
blocks.en: Mass extraction vs. vacuum decay: Both are "negative-pressure-driven" methods; the difference lies in the physical quantity measured. Vacuum decay measures the rate of pressure change (ΔP/Δt); mass extraction directly measures the mass or volume of gas extracted from the package. For packages with a large headspace volume (such as large infusion bags), the pressure change caused by a tiny leak may be very small (imprecise to measure), whereas directly metering the amount of gas extracted is more reliable.

blocks.zh: 真空衰減就像用壓力計測量輪胎氣壓隨時間的下降；質量萃取就像直接測量從輪胎中抽出了多少氣體分子。後者在輪胎體積很大（壓力變化不明顯）時更精確——例如你要檢測一個巨大的儲氣槽是否有微小洩漏。
blocks.en: Vacuum decay is like using a gauge to measure how a tire's pressure falls over time; mass extraction is like directly measuring how many gas molecules have been drawn out of the tire. The latter is more accurate when the tire volume is very large (the pressure change is not obvious), for example when you want to check whether a huge gas storage tank has a tiny leak.

blocks.zh: 質量萃取法在大體積靜脈輸液袋（如 500 mL 生理鹽水）的 CCI 測試中有明顯優勢，因為大袋子的少量氣體洩漏對壓力的影響很小，但直接量測萃取出的氣體量則更靈敏。在選擇測試方法時，包裝體積（Volume）是重要的決策因素。
blocks.en: Mass extraction has a clear advantage in CCI testing of large-volume intravenous infusion bags (e.g., 500 mL saline), because a small gas leak from a large bag has little effect on pressure, but directly measuring the amount of gas extracted is more sensitive. Package volume is an important factor when selecting a test method.

blocks.zh: 比較真空衰減法和質量萃取法：各自更適合什麼類型的包裝？請各舉一個具體例子。
blocks.en: Compare vacuum decay and mass extraction: which type of package is each better suited to? Give one specific example for each.

blocks.zh: 如果一個方法同時具有「確定性」和「非破壞性」兩個特點，對於生產線的 100% 檢測有什麼優勢？
blocks.en: If a method is both "deterministic" and "nondestructive", what advantages does that bring to 100% testing on a production line?

blocks.zh: 1.5 Tracer Gas Methods — Helium Mass Spectrometry | 示蹤氣體法——氦質譜法
blocks.en: 1.5 Tracer Gas Methods: Helium Mass Spectrometry

blocks.zh: Tracer gas leak test methods (示蹤氣體法) use a specific gas as a tracer to detect the presence and/or measure the rate of leakage. The most sensitive and widely used tracer gas method in pharmaceutical package integrity testing is Helium Mass Spectrometry (氦質譜法), referenced in USP 〈1207.2〉.
blocks.en: Tracer gas leak test methods use a specific gas as a tracer to detect the presence and/or measure the rate of leakage. The most sensitive and widely used tracer gas method in pharmaceutical package integrity testing is Helium Mass Spectrometry, referenced in USP <1207.2>.

blocks.zh: 為什麼選氦氣作示蹤氣體？
blocks.en: Why choose helium as the tracer gas?

blocks.zh: 氦（He）是最小的惰性氣體分子（原子序 2），穿透任何微小孔隙的能力最強
blocks.en: Helium (He) is the smallest inert gas molecule (atomic number 2) and has the strongest ability to penetrate any tiny opening

blocks.zh: 大氣中氦含量極低（約 5 ppm），背景值低、信噪比高
blocks.en: The atmospheric helium content is extremely low (about 5 ppm), giving a low background and a high signal-to-noise ratio

blocks.zh: 化學惰性，不與產品反應，不影響安全性
blocks.en: It is chemically inert, does not react with the product and does not affect safety

blocks.zh: 質譜儀對氦有極高靈敏度
blocks.en: The mass spectrometer has extremely high sensitivity to helium

blocks.zh: 靈敏度的意義：10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s 是什麼概念？如果有一個這麼小的洩漏孔，大約需要 3,000 年才能洩漏出 1 mL 的氣體。相比之下，MALL 的 6×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s 在感覺上「很大」——氦質譜法可以輕鬆偵測比 MALL 小 1,000 倍以上的洩漏。
blocks.en: What the sensitivity means: What does 10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s mean in practice? With a leak path this small, it would take about 3,000 years to leak 1 mL of gas. By comparison, the MALL of 6×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s feels "large". Helium mass spectrometry can easily detect leaks more than 1,000 times smaller than the MALL.

blocks.zh:
氦質譜法靈敏度：
真空模式靈敏度：~10⁻⁹ to 10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s

與其他方法的靈敏度比較：
氦質譜（真空模式）：  10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s
氦質譜（探針模式）：  10⁻⁷ mbar·L/s
真空衰減法：          10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s（高端儀器）
壓力衰減法：          10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³ mbar·L/s
HVLD：                依產品導電性而定
MALL（類別1剛性容器）：< 6×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s

→ 氦質譜法的靈敏度是 MALL 的 1,000–10,000 倍
→ 常用作其他方法的「黃金標準」校準基準
blocks.en:
Helium mass spectrometry sensitivity:
Vacuum mode sensitivity: ~10⁻⁹ to 10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/s

Sensitivity comparison with other methods:
Helium mass spectrometry (vacuum mode):  10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s
Helium mass spectrometry (sniffer mode): 10⁻⁷ mbar·L/s
Vacuum decay:                            10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s (high-end instruments)
Pressure decay:                          10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³ mbar·L/s
HVLD:                                    depends on product conductivity
MALL (Class 1 rigid containers):         < 6×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s

→ Helium mass spectrometry is 1,000–10,000 times more sensitive than the MALL
→ Commonly used as the "gold standard" calibration reference for other methods

blocks.zh: 氦質譜法作為「參考標準（Reference Standard）」的意義：USP 〈1207〉 在建立 MALL（< 6×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s）時，是以氦質譜法真空模式的測量值為基準的。這意味著，當你在驗證其他測試方法（如真空衰減法）時，通常需要使用氦質譜法來標定正對照（positive control）的真實洩漏速率，作為「相關性研究（correlation study）」的參考。
blocks.en: The significance of helium mass spectrometry as a reference standard: When USP <1207> established the MALL (< 6×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s), it used measurements from helium mass spectrometry in vacuum mode as the basis. This means that when you validate another test method (such as vacuum decay), you usually need helium mass spectrometry to calibrate the true leak rate of the positive control, as the reference for the correlation study.

blocks.zh: 產品充填問題：最靈敏的真空模式需要包裝內部充有氦氣，這對於商業批次測試是不實際的（不能把藥液換成氦氣）。因此氦質譜法主要用於方法開發、驗證研究和正對照標定，而非常規 100% 批放行測試。
blocks.en: The product filling problem: The most sensitive vacuum mode requires the inside of the package to be filled with helium, which is impractical for commercial batch testing (you cannot replace the drug solution with helium). Helium mass spectrometry is therefore mainly used for method development, validation studies and positive control calibration, not for routine 100% batch release testing.

blocks.zh: 在設計 CCI 方法驗證計畫時，你需要用氦質譜法做什麼？它與你選擇的常規測試方法（如真空衰減法）是什麼關係？
blocks.en: When designing a CCI method validation plan, what do you need helium mass spectrometry for? What is its relationship to the routine test method you choose (such as vacuum decay)?

blocks.zh: 氦質譜法的「真空模式」和「探針模式」各自的優缺點是什麼？在方法驗證中各自用途是什麼？
blocks.en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of the "vacuum mode" and the "sniffer mode" of helium mass spectrometry? What is each used for in method validation?

blocks.zh: 1.6 Method Selection Guidance | 方法選擇指引
blocks.en: 1.6 Method Selection Guidance

blocks.zh: 方法選擇的決策層次：
blocks.en: The decision hierarchy for method selection:

blocks.zh: 第一層：這個包裝是剛性還是彈性？（影響壓力/真空法適用性）
blocks.en: Level 1: Is the package rigid or flexible? (affects the applicability of pressure/vacuum methods)

blocks.zh: 第二層：產品是否導電？（決定 HVLD 是否適用）
blocks.en: Level 2: Is the product conductive? (determines whether HVLD is applicable)

blocks.zh: 第三層：是否需要監測頭部空間氣體組成？（決定是否優先考慮 TDLAS）
blocks.en: Level 3: Does the headspace gas composition need to be monitored? (determines whether TDLAS should be considered first)

blocks.zh: 第四層：是開發/驗證還是常規檢測？（決定是否需要氦質譜法作為參考）
blocks.en: Level 4: Is this development/validation or routine testing? (determines whether helium mass spectrometry is needed as a reference)

blocks.zh: 任何單一方法都不能滿足所有場景——大多數 CDMO 會組合使用 2–3 種方法（如 100% 真空衰減 + 穩定性 TDLAS + 方法驗證氦質譜）。
blocks.en: No single method meets every scenario. Most CDMOs use a combination of 2-3 methods (for example, 100% vacuum decay + TDLAS for stability + helium mass spectrometry for method validation).

blocks.zh: 監管期望的演變：2023 年 FDA 發布的 Container Closure Integrity Testing guidance 明確要求選擇能偵測 MALL 的方法，並且優先確定性方法。許多歐洲 EMA 市場也有類似要求。在 CMC 文件和 ANDA/NDA/BLA 申報中，必須說明：①為什麼選擇這個方法；②方法如何與 MALL 相關聯；③方法的靈敏度是否足夠。
blocks.en: Evolving regulatory expectations: The Container Closure Integrity Testing guidance issued by the FDA in 2023 explicitly requires selecting a method capable of detecting the MALL, and gives preference to deterministic methods. Many European EMA markets have similar requirements. In CMC documents and ANDA/NDA/BLA submissions, you must explain: (1) why this method was chosen; (2) how the method relates to the MALL; and (3) whether the method's sensitivity is sufficient.

blocks.zh: 典型的 CDMO CCI 驗證策略（以凍乾西林瓶為例）：
blocks.en: A typical CDMO CCI validation strategy (using a lyophilized vial as the example):

blocks.zh: 方法開發階段：氦質譜法標定 positive controls（建立洩漏速率 reference）
blocks.en: Method development stage: helium mass spectrometry calibrates the positive controls (establishing the leak rate reference)

blocks.zh: 100% 批放行：自動化真空衰減法（inline 或 offline）
blocks.en: 100% batch release: automated vacuum decay (inline or offline)

blocks.zh: 穩定性監測：TDLAS 頭部空間氧氣分析（非破壞性，可重複量測同一瓶）
blocks.en: Stability monitoring: TDLAS headspace oxygen analysis (nondestructive, repeated measurement of the same vial)

blocks.zh: 根本原因分析（OOS）：HVLD 或 He 質譜定位洩漏位置
blocks.en: Root cause analysis (OOS): HVLD or He mass spectrometry to locate the leak

blocks.zh: 一個含有氧敏感蛋白質的預充式注射器（PFS），充填的是水溶液，儲存於 2–8°C。你會選擇哪種確定性方法進行 CCI 驗證？請說明理由。
blocks.en: A prefilled syringe (PFS) containing an oxygen-sensitive protein, filled with an aqueous solution and stored at 2–8°C. Which deterministic method would you choose for CCI validation? Explain your reasons.

blocks.zh: 為什麼不能只用氦質譜法做所有的 CCI 測試？它的哪些特性使它不適合作為常規 100% 批放行測試？
blocks.en: Why can't helium mass spectrometry be used for all CCI testing? Which of its characteristics make it unsuitable as a routine 100% batch release test?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 確定性方法（Deterministic Methods）基於可預測物理化學原理，給出客觀定量數值，是 FDA 和現行業界最佳實踐優先推薦的 CCI 測試方法
blocks.en: Deterministic methods are based on predictable physical and chemical principles and give objective, quantitative values; they are the CCI test methods preferred by the FDA and current industry best practice

blocks.zh: 主要確定性方法：真空衰減法（通用剛性容器）、HVLD（導電液體產品）、TDLAS 頭部空間分析（氮氣保護/凍乾品）、質量萃取法（大體積容器）、氦質譜法（最高靈敏度參考標準）
blocks.en: Main deterministic methods: vacuum decay (general rigid containers), HVLD (conductive liquid products), TDLAS headspace analysis (nitrogen-protected/lyophilized products), mass extraction (large-volume containers), helium mass spectrometry (highest sensitivity, reference standard)

blocks.zh: 氦質譜法是靈敏度最高的「黃金標準」，主要用於方法驗證和正對照標定；MALL（< 6×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s）即以此為基準建立
blocks.en: Helium mass spectrometry is the most sensitive "gold standard", used mainly for method validation and positive control calibration; the MALL (< 6×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s) was established on this basis

blocks.zh: 方法選擇需考慮包裝類型、產品特性（導電性、頭部空間）、測試目的（開發 vs. 常規）和監管要求
blocks.en: Method selection must consider package type, product characteristics (conductivity, headspace), test purpose (development vs. routine) and regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: 一個完整的 CDMO CCI 策略通常組合使用多種方法：常規批放行 + 穩定性監測 + 方法驗證各用不同方法
blocks.en: A complete CDMO CCI strategy usually combines several methods: routine batch release, stability monitoring and method validation each use a different method
